changes_since_full_suite: Board consumes a selected recipe after the first submission or synthetic refusal; a second launch requires a fresh explicit review.
Native assertion checks that the confirmation button disappears after the synthetic refusal.
Native chart marks use the application amber tint instead of the platform default blue.
Separate host/desktop implementation and test edits are identified by the two source snapshots; these modules are excluded from the mobile build.

swift_device_typecheck.scope: Before final chart tint change; final simulator compilation covers that change. Device archive compilation is a separate release check.

fixture.spawn: Two meters outside the real Gym doorway, facing its interior.
fixture.lazy_interest: Actual native touch movement enters the building before synthetic rows appear. Background and walking out disable interest and clear the native board projection.
rows: Synthetic Terminal-Bench evaluation: completed,8/8,$0.12 fixture value.
fixture.charts: Recorded checks line and points, with exact values available through a native disclosure.
fixture.launch: Selecting a recipe does not launch it. Explicit confirmation returns a retained synthetic refusal and consumes the selection.

earlier_attempts.result: 16 passed,1 failed: the initial test incorrectly expected synthetic launch acceptance. The fixture deliberately refuses process execution. Corrected the assertion and test name to require rejection and no host receipt; retained the failed log.

visual_review.result: Run list, values, review controls, unknown-cost label, and synthetic refusal are readable. Final chart marks are amber.
visual_review.capture_limit: Some XCTest screenshots omit unchanged compositor layers, including the header/status bar and the last exact-value label; those elements are checked through native accessibility assertions. The run-list and recipe-review captures include their headers. This is not a physical display or camera validation.

limits: No physical iPhone, thermal, battery, VoiceOver navigation, or broad device-matrix claim.
The native fixture does not authenticate to a live Gym host or start a real recipe. Separate Rust host/relay evidence has its own scope.

Connection grants persist in device-only Keychain. Pending launch identity is retained across entry/background/reentry in memory, not durably restored after process death. Cold restart never retries automatically.
A completed record does not establish benchmark success. Unknown costs remain unavailable; no enforced dollar cap is claimed.

post_snapshot_changes.explanation: Only host-gated gym-bridge modules/tests and desktop-gated verse::app changed during the final native test. Mobile source and portable Board inputs remained unchanged.
